title: Two Boxes, One Address
tagline: Two boxes share one address, so the house stays online.
what: Two small computers that run my house's network side by side and share one address. Every phone and laptop asks that address where to go online; if the main box dies, the backup picks the address up and the house stays online.
built: Set up two boxes that both answer network lookups, with one shared address that moves to the survivor
Built a switch so only one box at a time hands out addresses to new devices
Wrote checks that compare the boxes and flag settings that no longer match
Tested the handover with a stopped box and a frozen one
credit: Built on Pi-hole and keepalived; the switch, the checks and the tests are mine

making.problem: Every phone and laptop needs network lookups to work. I wanted the house to stay online while either box was out of service.
how: Both boxes answer network lookups all day. The shared address moves to the one that can answer.
Only the box holding that address can hand out addresses to new devices. My switch keeps the other one quiet.
Small checks compare the settings, so the spare is ready to take over.

broke.title: Give a restart time to settle
broke.body: A restart once set off a reboot loop. I made the watchdog wait three minutes before acting and leave the first five minutes after boot alone.

credits: Switch, drift checks, tests and the lessons: me

log.text: Tested a stopped box: the spare took the shared address in 269 ms without losing network lookups.
Tested a frozen box too, with websites and new-device connections using the spare.
Put the address handout behind a switch, so moving it no longer restarts both boxes.

serviceRecord.purpose: The house stays online when a network box stops answering. The surviving box takes over the shared address.

receipt.title: The sites kept loading.
receipt.text: A frozen machine is different from a dead one. I froze a box on purpose: the spare took over in 11 seconds, and the websites kept loading during the test.

serviceRecord.care: Keep the two boxes alike. Drift checks compare their settings before the spare has to take over.

back.pitch: Two small computers share the job of keeping the house online. One can leave service without leaving every phone and laptop stranded.
cut: Both answer lookups; only one hands out addresses.
Settings comparisons that catch drift between the boxes.
